relationSemanticF1.formula: F1 over the set of semantic relation identities

denominators.gold: all gold relation identities in the scored case or slice
denominators.predicted: all predicted relation identities in the scored case or slice

relationSemanticF1.zeroDenominator: not-applicable only when gold and predicted sets are both empty

relationEvidenceSupport.identity: a semantically matched relation pair plus a valid evidence span
relationEvidenceSupport.supportPolicy: the evidence span passes source/code-point integrity and the versioned evidence policy for the matched endpoints and predicate trigger
relationEvidenceSupport.formula: supported semantic true positives divided by semantic relation true positives
relationEvidenceSupport.zeroDenominator: not-applicable; never convert to semantic relation zero

relationEvidenceExact.identity: a semantically matched relation pair plus an exact adjudicated evidence span
relationEvidenceExact.exactness: predicted half-open offsets equal one of the valid gold spans for the same semantic relation
relationEvidenceExact.formula: exact evidence matches divided by semantic relation true positives
relationEvidenceExact.zeroDenominator: not-applicable; never convert to semantic relation zero
relationEvidenceExact.multipleValidSpans: any one of the adjudicated valid spans satisfies exactness

legacyMetrics.relations.f1: historical exact predicate-endpoint-span score; report for continuity only and do not use as relation semantic quality
